title: Kit playground
tagline: Dev only: every mini-game, one page each.
mystery: Does every mini-game in the kit work?
intro: Kit playground. Each page is one mini-game. Skip moves on.
drive.hint: Drag the stick or use the arrow keys. Bumps make you hop!
echo.hint: Fire, then tap again the moment the light comes back.
dip.hint: Watch the line. A dip means a planet is crossing the star.
hover.hint: Hold to spin the rotors. Keep the marker in the green band.
sun.hint: Slide left and right to keep the marker in the green band.
power.hint: Use your actions before the meter runs out.
power.devil: A dust devil cleaned the panels!
